versions.changelog: Rebrand to Anvil AI. Remove CacheForge marketing copy. Normalize install commands.
Docs: normalize CacheForge footer and CTA.
Launch: CacheForge skills wave 1. Discord v2 delivery, security hardened, production-grade.

- Initial release of the prom-query skill for querying and interpreting Prometheus-compatible metrics.
- Provides commands to query instant values, timeseries data, active alerts, scrape targets, and metric/rule exploration.
- Includes guidance for translating natural language questions to PromQL queries.
- Summarizes and interprets range query results with trends, spikes, and context-driven advice.
- Features incident triage workflow and alert interpretation recommendations.
- Supports Discord v2 delivery with compact summaries and quick action components.
- All interactions are read-only with robust error handling and large-result management.
